title: MOSS-Image: Text to Image
summary: Generate an image from a text prompt with MOSS-Image, an open-weights model that reads a full scene caption and returns one finished image. A prompt upsampler expands a short request into that caption first, so a one-line description is enough. Ideal for editorial photography, product shots, and concept art.
